issues.title: WebUI map launch was rejected by invalid generated Galaxy adapters
issues.detail: Generated invoke adapters could emit MapScript-local functions into the funcref table and pass libCOTF_gs_HistogramData structrefs by value. SC2 then rejected the map script during load. The generator now excludes MapScript-local funcref targets and emits structref adapters fail-closed without illegal value copies. A real WebUI launch of TerranAlenger3 + 亡者之夜.SC2Map reached the runtime listener and initialization Bank with no new non-empty ScriptError.
issues.nextAction: 保留生成器回归测试；后续全量 adapter 三档探针仍按 Stage 26 计划执行。

issues.title: WebUI direct-map launch treated an optional P2 unit marker as mandatory
issues.detail: 初始化 gate 已正确按 CMCoopLaunchProfile 写入每项 readiness：亡者之夜要求 P1/P2 防败建筑和 P1 起始单位，不要求 P2 起始单位，因此 initialization_units_ready_p2=0 是预期。Wait-CmreRuntimeListener 旧实现仍无条件要求 P1/P2 building/unit 全部为 1，导致 WebUI 已进图、listener 已就绪且 heartbeat 递增后仍在 420 秒超时。现改为按 map-requirements 的 preventDefeat/startingUnits 玩家范围判定，并在失败时打印末次 Bank 快照。
issues.nextAction: 保留 map-specific marker regression；新增地图时同步维护 map-requirements.json。

issues.title: WebUI repeat-launch ownership guard still needs an uncontended live MVP
issues.detail: WebUI now binds a detached player runtime only after its own async launcher exits and the intent, lease, runtime PID, creation timestamp, trusted launcher path, selected map/commander, SC2 executable identity, and command line all agree. The implementation is covered by 56 static WebUI/launcher tests, including UTF-16 command-line decoding for Chinese map names and fail-closed mismatch cases. The final double-click runtime check remains open because the latest WebUI launch PID 47648 hit the GameLogs map-load gate while an unrelated SC2_x64.exe PID 46256 (-listen 127.0.0.1 -port 5006 -debug) was active without WebUI ownership. That process was preserved.
issues.nextAction: After all untracked SC2/SC2Switcher processes and foreign listeners have exited, run two POST /api/launch-async requests for TerranAlenger3 + 亡者之夜.SC2Map. Verify the original WebUI-owned runtime PID is gone, the second PID reaches the map, bridge_heartbeat advances, and no non-empty ScriptError is added.

issues.title: Full generated-adapter runtime validation completed under approved launcher
issues.detail: 2026-08-10 使用 approved launcher 完成 100 -> 1000 -> -InvokeFull 放量，三次均在启动器归属的 API 窗口内执行 CreateGame/JoinGame、kernel 注册、system.ping、vibe.unit.spawn 的 raw observation +1 Marine、query.units=1，并通过同窗口 no_new_nonempty ScriptError gate。Tier100 中 gen.1 成功、gen.202 按挂载范围预期返回 FUNCTION_NOT_IN_MAP；Tier1000 与 -InvokeFull 中 gen.1 和 gen.202 均成功。TerranAlenger3 预选启动日志与同窗口地图进入证据也闭合 commander startup。旧的文件锁、Bank XML parse、非归属 5000 API 会话阻塞均已被本轮独立启动器窗口解除。Module 1 Step 4 类型族 sample/census 已保持 PASS。
issues.resolution: Use -InvokeTier 100 and -InvokeTier 1000 for bounded rollout, then -InvokeFull for full generated dispatch. Keep InvokeTier=0 as disabled baseline only.
issues.nextAction: 保留回归探针和 ScriptError gate；后续不要把 -InvokeTier 0 或旧同哈希重命名地图作为全量 evidence。

issues.evidence: Get-FileHash output recorded in stages/26-full-function-invoke/log.md plus tier100-live-verdict-stage26-approved-tier100-20260810.json, tier100-live-verdict-stage26-approved-tier1000-20260810.json, tier100-live-verdict-stage26-approved-full-20260810.json
issues.nextAction: 任何后续放量证据必须记录实际 packed map 大小、SHA-256、挂载档位和对应 live verdict。

issues.title: WebUI-selected commander startup reaches the map without the selection screen
issues.detail: 静态覆盖已证明 CommanderSelectionScreen 与 saved-profile startup 分支被替换为 CMRE_ON_DEMAND_PRESELECTED_COMMANDER_STARTUP。2026-08-10 的 approved launcher 使用 TerranAlenger3，stdout 记录 `CMRE preselected startup: 亡者之夜.SC2Map x TerranAlenger3`、`CMRE commander-selection fallback already absent` 与预选 overlay 应用；随后同一 API 窗口完成 CreateGame/JoinGame、kernel 注册、spawn/query/function.invoke 和零新增非空 ScriptError。该 MVP 证明真实输入到达真实地图启动路径，不再需要玩家打开指挥官选择界面。
issues.resolution: 入口只能走预选 commander 后直接进入地图；选择界面入口保持禁用。
issues.nextAction: 如后续需要视觉证据，可补截图；当前阶段的 live map-entry MVP 已闭环。

issues.title: Top-level dispatch routed 6,108 functions to the wrong shard (position-based sharding vs range-based routing)
issues.detail: 自审发现：顶层两级区间分派按全局 id 区间路由（(id-1)//SHARD_SIZE），而分片按 available 列表位置切分；每图 available 子集存在空洞（如 ids 2548/2549 缺失）导致 6,108 个函数被路由到不含自身 adapter 的分片，产生 FUNCTION_NOT_IN_MAP 假阴性。修复为按全局 id 区间切分（区间号 = 分片号，空洞区间跳过），顶层路由与片内成员构造性一致。
issues.nextAction: 回归测试已防复发；任何分片粒度调整必须保持分片号与全局区间号一致。

issues.title: Structref arguments are explicitly fail-closed because the catalog has no producer
issues.detail: invoke-plan.json 复核确认目录中无函数返回 structref；仅有的 2 个 structref 参数函数是 gen.9746/libCOTF_gf_HistogramHorizontalCreate 和 gen.9747/libCOTF_gf_HistogramVerticalCreate，二者的 histogram 入参只能来自其他调用返回值。生成器已对该参数族 fail-closed，未知句柄返回 HANDLE_NOT_FOUND，不伪装运行时成功。
issues.nextAction: None - closed as a verified catalog limitation; keep the generated adapters fail-closed and do not fabricate structref handles.

issues.title: 7 same-name ambiguous signatures excluded from the invoke plan
issues.detail: 当前 22,780 个 owned-source 声明生成 11,676 个唯一可调用 adapter，另有 7 个同名但签名冲突且无法静态消歧的函数被排除：AICampaignDiffSelect、gf_AttackWaveatTime、gf_CreateEscortUnit、gf_SendEscortUnit、gf_TimerColor、gf_UpdateBonusObjectiveTimer、gf_UpdateBonusObjectiveUI。整数 id 分派以唯一签名为单位，排除为如实记账而非遗漏。
issues.nextAction: 如后续需要调用这 7 个函数，引入显式重载消歧参数（按完整签名选 id）而非自动猜测。

issues.title: Historical CMRE declaration difference is explained by the frozen clean baseline
issues.detail: Stage 25 已冻结当前可复现基线 catalog-baseline.json（35,314 declarations，SHA-256 前缀 93659957...）。清洁扫描包含 owned packages 22,780 条和 cmre-dev 12,534 条，0 parse errors；cmre-dev 相对 owned source 新增 0 个 unique signature。历史 35,404 原始 entry list 不可恢复，差异的 90 条属于扫描期间移除的 cmre-dev redundant layer declarations，对 adapter coverage 无影响，因此无需代码修复或继续寻找缺失函数。
issues.nextAction: None - closed. Keep catalog-baseline.json as the reproducible declaration baseline and do not change the owned-source generator boundary.

issues.title: -InvokeTier top-level launcher passthrough implemented
issues.detail: 初版误判 launch-cmre-alenger.ps1 在 writeScope 之外（实际 project.json writeScope 含该文件）。已补齐：顶层参数 [int]$InvokeTier = 0（0=禁用生成 bundle，100/1000=分档）与 [switch]$InvokeFull；两者互斥校验防止把 0 误当全量。PS1 AST 语法校验通过；静态测试 test_launcher_top_level_passes_invoke_tier_to_observer_overlay 防复发。
issues.nextAction: 后续放量顺序必须是 -InvokeTier 100、-InvokeTier 1000、-InvokeFull；普通 WebUI/InvokeTier=0 维持稳定禁用生成 bundle。

issues.title: 地图列表不能把英文内部文件名作为用户可见名称
issues.detail: WebUI 地图 API 现由显式中文注册表为 CMRE、虫心和起义狂潮的 66 张地图提供 name；内部 id 仅用于启动参数和预设持久化。虫心与起义狂潮分别使用 [虫心]、[起义狂潮] 前缀区分来源。
issues.resolution: 已完成显式中文名称登记、前端显示路径替换和回归测试。
issues.nextAction: 后续新增地图必须先登记中文显示名；未知地图应保持 fail-closed，不得回退展示原始文件名。2026-08-12 已补充真实浏览器点击地图页、DOM 断言和截图证据。

issues.title: Reborn Zerg commanders received an unintended synthetic starting tech bundle
issues.detail: Reborn SwarmSetup previously called libRebornAdapter_gf_CreateZergStartingBuildings for every Zerg commander, creating extra tech structures, workers, Overlord, HunterKiller and Queen at game start. The launcher now removes that call and the initialization gate no longer waits for its completion markers. Static coverage confirms all seven Reborn Zerg commanders: Abathur, Dehaka, Izsha, Kerrigan, Naktul, Stukov and Zagara. A real packed Abathur map produced the expected 24 Drone, 2 Hatchery, 6 Larva and 1 Overlord baseline with zero synthetic extra Zerg buildings; P1 raw observation plus Kernel spawn/query validation passed and no new ScriptError was observed.
issues.nextAction: Keep the seven-commander static regression and do not restore the synthetic tech-bundle call without a new commander-specific contract.
